summary.text: Sam Wengryn is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 24, who took office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Joel Fry, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: For 2025-2026 Wengryn serves on the Environmental Protection, Local Government and Natural Resources committees and is vice chair of the Public Safety Committee.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, and Democrat Sonya Hicks won her party's primary for the seat.
